programme.title: Snooker: Turniej Shanghai Masters – mecz finałowy: Allister Carter – Kyren Wilson
programme.desc: It's time to meet the champion of the sixteenth edition of Shanghai Masters. The winner of the final duel will receive a cash prize of over £200,000. This amount would certainly satisfy Kyren Wilson. The Englishman wants to win his second title in China this year

programme.title: Alpine skiing: World Championships - Saalbach-Hinterglemm 2025 - women's downhill
programme.desc: It's time to decide the women's competition in the fastest alpine skiing competition. In the previous edition of the world championships, Jasmine Flury was happy to win the gold medal in the downhill. Federica Brignone and Sofia Goggia, among others, are eager to be dethroned

programme.title: Olympic Games: monuments
programme.desc: sports magazine

programme.title: FIA World Endurance Championship: Bahrain 8 Hours – summary
programme.desc: The last round of this long-distance racing season. On the Bahrain International track, Robert Kubica and his colleagues from the private AF Corse team could have won the title of world drivers' champions. For this to happen, however, they had to score at least 14 points and also count on a stumble by Antonio Giovanazzi and Ferrari AF Corse, who were 13 points behind them.

programme.title: World Touring Car Cup: Race in China – summary
Cyclo-cross cycling: Superprestige – Niel – women's race
programme.desc: The second competition of this year's series was won by Sara Casasola. In Overijse, the Italian defeated, among others, Lucinda Brand and Aniek van Alphen. Now he wants to repeat his feat in Niel and thus strengthen his lead in the general classification

programme.title: Cyclo-cross cycling: Superprestige – Niel – men's race
programme.desc: The third Superprestige race this season will take place in Niel, Belgium. Michael Vanthourenhout seems to be the favorite in the competition, leading the general classification after recent victories in Ruddervoorde and Overijse

programme.title: FIA World Endurance Championship: 24 Hours of Le Mans
programme.desc: A year ago, Robert Kubica, still a driver of Team WRT in the LMP2 class, took second place during one of the most important WEC races. This time, the Pole will start in the Hypercar class in the AF Corse team. So far, the Polish driver's best result was fourth place in Lusayl. Will he stand on the podium for the first time this season during the competition in the legendary Le Mans?

programme.title: Martial arts: FEN 47 in Ostróda. Kacper Formela – Nurzhan Akishev 17/06/2023
programme.desc: Kacper Formela defended the FEN champion belt in the featherweight category twice. He finished both fights in the first round. How will his fight with Nurzhan Akishev go? The title of lightweight champion will be the fight between Łukasz Charzewski and Patryk Duński. During the competition in Ostróda, fans will also see other interesting fights, e.g. Adrian Zieliński with Maksim Grabowicz or Michał Borowski with Patryk Semeniuk

programme.title: Figure Skating: NHK Trophy in Osaka
programme.desc: The fourth competition in this year's Grand Prix series. Soloists Yuma Kagiyama and Kaori Sakamoto will try to defend the title won last season. The competition between sports pairs will include, among others: Italians Sara Conti and Niccolo Macii, while their compatriots Charlene Guignard and Marco Fabbri will take part in the dance pair competition. Unfortunately, we will not see any Polish representatives in Osaka

programme.title: Football: German League. 1. FC Union Berlin – FC Bayern Munich
programme.desc: Bayern Munich is rushing like a torpedo in the fight for the German championship. He recorded complete victories in nine matches. Harry Kane and company are eager for another win, but they still remember last campaign, when they only drew 1-1 on the pitch of the An der Alten Försterei stadium.

programme.title: Football: Dutch League. FC Utrecht – AFC Ajax Amsterdam
programme.desc: Roderick Weusthof's players will host Ajax Amsterdam. Utrecht won the previous round against NEC Nijmegen 1-0, while Ajax drew with Heerenveen 1-1. The last direct match between these teams ended with a high victory for Utrecht (4-0)

programme.title: Figure Skating: NHK Trophy in Osaka

They are also by far the most effective team in Serie A with 24 goals scored. Polish fans hope that Piotr Zieliński will reappear in the Milanese squad, who scored a beautiful goal in the win against Hellas Verona a week ago

programme.desc: A clash of two teams that have recently shown excellent performance. AZ Alkmaar intends to reduce the gap to Feyenoord and PSV Eindhoven, leaders in the table. However, the team from Philips Stadion does not intend to make the task easier for Maarten Martens's players

The ring will also feature, among others: Nikodem Jeżewski

programme.desc: After three rounds, the team from Kędzierzyn-Koźle has two points, but no victory. The fourth team from last season had a better start to the season. The Jastrzębie team won the first two matches and only in the third round they did not face Projekt Warszawa

programme.title: Polsat SiatCast
programme.desc: Volleyball arouses great emotions in Poland. They will also be featured in the new TV and Internet program "Polsat SiatCast". Hosts Marek Magiera and Jakub Bednaruk will discuss topics related to club and national volleyball. However, they will not provide fans with dry analyzes of individual matches, but will often juxtapose extremely different opinions on a given issue.

Thanks to this victory, they are undefeated after three rounds, just like PGE Projekt Warszawa and Asseco Resovia Rzeszów. programme.desc: The beginning of the competition in PlusLiga showed that the team from Gdańsk should be able to fight for medal positions this season. programme.desc: For the second time in this edition of the Conference League, the Medalists will face a representative of the Czech top league. programme.desc: The Pride of Podlasie started the league phase of the youngest UEFA competition with a modest victory over Hamrun Spartans 1-0. In the second round, Adrian Siemieniec's players faced the strong RC Strasbourg, drawing with them away 1-1. Now they are on a delegation to Skopje. KF Shkendija has a 0-2 defeat against Rayo Vallecano and a 1-0 victory over Shelbourne FC. Jagiellonia will be the favorite in the match at the stadium. Todor Proeski. programme.title: Football: Conference League. NK Celje – Legia Warszawa
programme.desc: The club from the capital has two matches against difficult opponents. In the first match against Samsunspor (0:1) they failed to score points, but in the match against Shakhtar Donetsk the Military team won the full pool (2:1). Celje, on the other hand, has been flawless so far - first they beat AEK Athens and then Shamrock Rovers

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Rayo Vallecano – Lech Poznań
programme.desc: In the 3rd series of matches of the regular round, a difficult test awaits Kolejorz, who will face Rayo Vallecano away. However, the Polish champion has a lot of experience when it comes to playing in European cups. He should approach the clash with the eighth force of the previous LaLiga season without any complexes and with faith in victory. Lech fans are counting on a repeat of 2022, when the Poznań locomotive won LK 3-0 against Villarreal

programme.desc: November started for Matty Cash and his teammates with a Premier League defeat against Liverpool. Aston Villa will want to get back to winning ways quickly. The first opportunity is a Europa League clash with Maccabi Tel Aviv

programme.title: Football: UEFA Europa League. FC Utrecht – FC Porto
programme.desc: In the fourth round of the Europa League, Roderick Weusthof's players will face FC Porto, played by Jan Bednarek and Jakub Kiwior. The Dutch team has not scored any points so far, and in the last match they lost to SC Freiburg 0:2. In turn, the Portuguese team lost in the previous round against Nottingham Forest (0:2), thus stopping their series of matches without defeat.

programme.desc: Denys Berinczyk and Keyshawn Davis will fight for the WBO World lightweight belt at Madison Square Garden in New York. The title is defended by a boxer from Ukraine, who took it from Emanuel Navarette in May last year. He won by split decision

programme.desc: A reminder of the most important events in the history of Polish sport. A reminder of the football match between the Netherlands and Poland played on September 10, 1975 as part of the qualifying round for Euro 1976. This match is considered by many experts to be the best played by Orły Górski, and maybe even the best in the history of the Polish national team. sports magazine

programme.title: Football: World Cup qualifying: Poland – Malta
programme.desc: In the second qualifying match of the world championship, Michał Probierz's players will face the Maltese team at the PGE National Stadium in Warsaw. The White and Reds' rivals are only 168th in the FIFA rankings. This will be the first meeting of both teams in 22 years

programme.title: Betclic 1st league magazine | E52
programme.desc: A magazine summarizing the most important events of the last round of Betclic 1st league. The program will include discussions of individual matches, goals and the most beautiful goalkeeper parades. football magazine

programme.title: Women's football: ORLEN Ekstraliga: Czarni Sosnowiec – Lech Poznań UAM
programme.desc: Overdue match of the first round. KTS Enea Siarkopol Tarnobrzeg has played two matches so far. Both ended with her victories. PGE Fibrain AZS Politechnika Rzeszów has one match under its belt, also ending with a victory

programme.title: GOL
programme.desc: Polish league match highlights. The creators of the program present the most interesting actions and all goals from the matches played so far... football magazine

programme.title: Who won the match
programme.desc: The story of thirteen Polish representatives who played at the first ever Women's FIFA World Cup, which took place in Barranquilla, Colombia. The camera accompanies the team on its journey - both on and off the pitch... Poland. 2025. documentary film

programme.title: Hockey: European Nations Cup in Sosnowiec – summary
programme.desc: The teams of Poland, Italy, Great Britain and Slovenia competed in ArcelorMittal Park in Sosnowiec. For the White and Reds, this is the first stage of preparations for next year's Division 1A world championships. It was also Pekka Tirkkonen's debut on the bench of our national team

programme.title: Sport in Poland – a hundred years of history
programme.desc: The document summarizes the successes of Polish athletes over the century. In presenting their achievements and failures, the filmmakers took into account the context of changes in the global Olympic movement. The image combines the form of a classic documentary with a clip based on the emotions of loyal fans. It is a sentimental journey through the history of Polish sport, including the heroes thanks to whom our country is worthily represented on the international arena. The well-executed story brings to mind a fairy tale read to his grandson by his grandfather from an ancient book... Poland. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: TVP Sport quiz – Winter sports
programme.desc: Sports experts and journalists test their knowledge on various topics related to football... game show

programme.desc: The second meeting of Club Brugge KV players in front of their home audience in this edition of the Champions League. In the previous season, at the inauguration of the competition, they showed an excellent performance, beating AS Monaco 4-1. Will they be able to maintain their good streak at home against FC Barcelona? The team of Robert Lewandowski and Wojciech Szczęsny started the competition in a short period of time - first they defeated Newcastle FC, and then they lost to Paris Saint-Germain

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Finals in Riyadh - singles group stage match: Amanda Anisimova - Madison Keys
programme.desc: Both tennis players started their competition in the capital of Saudi Arabia with defeats. Amanda Anisimova lost to Jelena Rybakina in two sets. Madison Keys, in turn, had to acknowledge the superiority of Iga Świątek. The Americans have never played against each other before

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Finals Tournament in Riyadh - doubles group stage match: Weronika Kudermietowa/EliseMertens - Asia Muhammad/Demi Schuurs
programme.desc: The event in Riyadh started unsuccessfully for both teams. Weronika Kudermietowa and Elise Mertens had to admit the superiority of Su-Wei Hsieh and Jelena Ostapenko. Asia Muhammad and Demi Schuurs, in turn, lost to Sara Errani and Jasmine Paolini

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Finals Tournament in Riyadh - doubles group stage match: Katerina Siniakova/Taylor Townsend - Gabriela Dabrowski/Erin Routliffe
programme.desc: Both duos had a successful start in the WTA Finals. Katerina Siniakova and Taylor Townsend defeated Timea Babos and Luisa Stefani after a super tie-break (6:2, 3:6, 10:6). Gabriela Dabrowski and Erin Routliffe won in two sets against Mirra Andrejewa/Diana Shnaider

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Finals in Riyadh - singles group stage match: Coco Gauff - Jasmine Paolini
programme.desc: Coco Gauff and Jasmine Paolini recently met in the semi-finals of the tournament in Wuhan. The American turned out to be better and won 6:4, 6:3. In Riyadh, both tennis players started their competition with a defeat. The Italian lost 0-2 to Aryna Sabalenko, and the defending champion lost in three sets to her compatriot, Jessica Pegula

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Finals tournament in Riyadh - singles group stage match: Aryna Sabalenka - Jessica Pegula
programme.desc: Aryna Sabalenka will want to take revenge on Jessica Pegula for her recent defeat in the semi-finals of the tournament in Wuhan. There she succumbed after a three-set fight. In Riyadh, at the inauguration, the Belarusian defeated Jasmine Paolini without any problems. The American defeated Coco Gauff 2:1

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Finals in Riyadh - doubles group stage match: Mirra Andrejewa/Diana Shnaider - Timea Babos/Luisa Stefani
programme.desc: Both pairs started this year's WTA Finals unsuccessfully. Mirra Andrejewa and Diana Shnaider were unable to cope with the Gabriela Dabrowski/Erin Routliffe duo (3:6, 6:7). In turn, Timea Babos and Luisa Stefani lost to Katerina Siniakova and Taylor Townsend after a super tie-break (2:6, 6:3, 6:10).

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Finals Tournament in Riyadh - doubles group stage match: Sara Errani/Jasmine Paolini - Weronika Kudermietowa/Elise Mertens

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Finals tournament in Riyadh - singles group stage match: Yelena Rybakina - Ekaterina Aleksandrova

Kazashka will thus face the reserve player, Ekaterina Aleksandrova

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E01
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan explore the history of the woolly mammoth and the saber-toothed cat. Thanks to modern technologies, these huge mammals are brought back to life. Researchers are looking for answers to the question of why animals perfectly adapted to extreme conditions became extinct when the ice began to melt. Michaela discovers a weakness of a prehistoric hunter that may have contributed to his extinction. Meanwhile, Steve learns about a revolutionary gene-editing technique that can revive mammoths. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E02
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. The Ice Age became an arena of struggle between Neanderthals and representatives of Homo sapiens. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan investigate how two competing species have adapted to extreme conditions. Backshall explores southern Germany, where he discovers traces of the life of early humans and their ability to deal with prehistoric predators using advanced tools and weapons. In turn, Strachan examines the differences in anatomy and skills between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. It turns out that despite the physical advantage of the former, the latter showed greater abilities in long-distance running and technological innovation. The key technology that gave them the advantage was the sewing needle, which allowed them to create tighter clothing. The decisive moment that led to the extinction of Neanderthals was global warming and environmental changes that left Homo sapiens as the dominant species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Abel Resino» Abel Resino holds the unbeaten record in the history of LaLiga. As an Atlético de Madrid player, he entered the Guinness Book by keeping a clean sheet for 1,275 minutes, which goes from November 25, 1990, in which Claudio scored a goal against him in Mallorca-Atlético and March 17, 1991, on matchday 26, when Luis Enrique managed to beat him in the 45th minute of Atlético-Sporting de Gijón played in Vicente Calderon. A total of 14 consecutive games without conceding a goal in the 1990/1991 season. A mark that is still valid in professional football and that helped him win the Zamora trophy with 17 goals conceded in 33 games. Champion of the Copa del Rey, in 1995 he decided to sign for Rayo Vallecano of Madrid to play his last active season. Abel played a total of 264 games in the highest category of Spanish football

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Diego Rodríguez» Diego Rodríguez was a professional footballer from 1977 in his native Tenerife until 1998 when he decided to leave Albacete Balompié to play for Dos Hermanas. An expeditious and brave defender, he played 6 years and 198 games with Betis, of which he became captain until he signed for Sevilla. A change of colors that is traumatic in its meaning between the two teams from the same city and that still remains in the memory of the green-and-whites who have not forgiven him, and the white-and-reds who venerate the person who was also their captain. At the Nervión club, Diego played 8 seasons, 252 games

As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. In this film, Chad will be present at the dismantling of the C-5, which is planned to be reconstructed so that it will fly for another twenty years. In this film, you'll see engineer and presenter Chad Zdenek spend a full week aboard the USS Carl Vinson to observe the highly skilled technicians, engineers, mechanics and sailors who keep this incredible floating city in top condition while on a mission in the Pacific, providing training for 20 F18 pilots who have never flown from an aircraft carrier before. programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S11 EP12

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S11 EP13
programme.desc: Trong khi cả nhóm tiếp tục truy đuổi đường hầm khó nắm bắt trong Hố tiền, có rất nhiều bằng chứng cho thấy đầm lầy được sử dụng cho hoạt động dỡ hàng và manh mối mới về Lô 5 chỉ ra Thuyền trưởng Phipps.

programme.title: HAZARDOUS HISTORY WITH HENRY WINKLER S1 EP06
programme.desc: Từ những chiếc ô tô phát nổ và thảm họa khinh khí cầu cho đến những đứa trẻ được gửi qua đường bưu điện và những chiếc trực thăng cá nhân bị hủy diệt, quá khứ chứa đầy những câu chuyện du lịch đáng kinh ngạc đã mở đường cho giao thông vận tải hiện đại.

programme.title: HOLY MARVELS WITH DENNIS QUAID S2 EP19
programme.desc: Trong nhiều thế kỷ, các đồ tạo tác mạnh mẽ đã gây ra các cuộc chiến tranh, truyền cảm hứng truyền thuyết và các đế chế định hình. Từ vũ khí thiêng liêng đến di tích thiêng liêng-đây là những câu chuyện đáng kinh ngạc về những điều kỳ diệu hùng mạnh nhất thế giới.

programme.title: THE UNXPLAINED WITH WILLIAM SHATNER S3 EP33

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này mang đến những lực lượng đặc biệt tốt nhất từ ​​Iron Squad để thực hiện một thử thách mới - Dodgeball. 26 người chơi sẽ tham gia một cuộc thi khốc liệt, cho đến khi một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao mạnh mẽ và sức mạnh tinh thần được hình thành. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ cạnh tranh trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên Dodgeball huyền thoại!

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình đưa các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào vòng đấm bốc của người nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu nữ đầu tiên của người Thái và mùa 3 có hai huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh cho chức vô địch. Chương trình quyền anh độc đáo này cung cấp giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận đánh thực sự với máu!

programme.title: CỖ MÁY CHIẾN ĐẤU - THE FIGHT MACHINE
programme.desc: Hai người Canada trẻ từ những thế giới hoàn toàn khác nhau bị mắc kẹt trong một cuộc sống ngoài tầm kiểm soát của anh ta. Khi họ bị kéo vào mạch chiến đấu trần trụi dưới lòng đất không thể tha thứ, vụ va chạm của họ đã gây ra một hành trình tàn bạo của sự báo thù, sự trừng phạt và khám phá bản thân.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ lính nữ ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị lực lượng đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thách thức trên khắp đất liền, biển và không khí. Những người bảo vệ nữ hàng đầu tạo thành các đội bốn người để cạnh tranh với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cuối cùng trước sáu chủ nhà nổi tiếng!

programme.title: QUAN VÂN TRƯỜNG - THE LOST BLADESMAN
programme.desc: Một cuộc phiêu lưu lịch sử hoành tráng lấy bối cảnh trong thời kỳ hỗn loạn của ba vương quốc. Cao Cao cố gắng tranh thủ Guan Yu vào lực lượng của mình, nhưng Guan trung thành với anh trai tuyên thệ Liu Bei, người cũng là kẻ thù của Cao. Khi Guan cố gắng giải cứu Liu Bei, người vợ lẽ từ Cao, anh ta buộc phải chiến đấu theo cách của mình. Cuối cùng anh ta có thể thành công không?

programme.title: BẠN CÓ AN TOÀN? - ARE YOU SAFE?, TẬP 3
programme.desc: Bộ phim xoay quanh ba chàng ngự lâm lang thang khắp thế giới Internet. Dù tính cách khác nhau nhưng đều có chung lý tưởng là công nghệ hóa mọi điều tốt đẹp. Họ cùng nhau chiến đấu chống lại một số nhóm tội phạm Internet và phải đối mặt với những nguy hiểm rình rập.

programme.title: ĐẠI PHỤNG ĐẢ CANH NHÂN - GUARDIANS OF THE DAFENG, TẬP 11
programme.desc: Dương Lăng có khao khát trở thành cảnh sát, nhưng một tai nạn ập đến khiến anh lạc vào một thế giới khác. Khi tỉnh lại, anh thấy mình đang bị giam trong ngục chờ bị áp giải ra biên cương. Để thay đổi số mệnh bi đát, anh bắt buộc phải tự rửa oan cho mình và gia nhập tổ chức Đả Canh Nhân.

programme.title: BÍ ẨN RỪNG GIÀ - CRYING FOREST, TẬP 10
programme.desc: Một nhóm bạn tụ họp sau nhiều năm xa cách, họ quyết định tổ chức một buổi cắm trại trong rừng. Mọi việc đều diễn ra vui vẻ cho tới khi họ vô tình bước vào khu vực cấm, hàng loạt sự kiện bất thường xảy ra.

programme.title: CUỒNG PHONG - THE KNOCKOUT, TẬP 30

programme.title: KẺ TRỘM DANH TÍNH - PHẦN 2 - STOLEN IDENTITY 2
programme.desc: Một vài tháng sau khi phá được vụ án giết người hàng loạt, một xác chết mới lại được tìm thấy trong khu vực. Thám tử Manabu Kagaya cố gắng tìm ra sự thật. Anh đến gặp kẻ giết người hàng loạt Yoshiharu Urano đang bị giam giữ trong tù. Hắn tiết lộ cho Manabu về một nhân vật bí ẩn có biệt danh M, một kẻ giết người khát máu nguy hiểm và thông minh.

programme.title: CUỒNG PHONG - THE KNOCKOUT, TẬP 26
programme.desc: Năm 2021, vấn nạn tham nhũng đã len lỏi vào tận ngóc ngách bộ máy chính quyền thành phố Kinh Hải. Trong cuộc đấu tranh chống lại các thế lực tà ác, An Hân, cảnh sát hình sự tuyến đầu ở Kinh Hải, liên tục bị tấn công nhưng không thể truy bắt kẻ ác đến cùng vì một bên nào đó đã bảo vệ chúng

programme.title: NHẤT NIỆM QUAN SƠN - A JOURNEY TO LOVE, TẬP 10
programme.desc: Trong khi mọi người trong sứ đoàn đang ngủ say thì Như Ý bí mật gặp người của Chu Y Vệ. Trước đó, cô cố tình để lại dấu vết trên cơ thể của Việt Tam Nương và Ngọc Lang nhằm tìm ra kẻ chủ mưu đằng sau. Cô ấy không ngờ rằng cuộc gặp này đã bị Tiền Chiêu nhìn thấy.

programme.title: BÍ ẨN RỪNG GIÀ - CRYING FOREST, TẬP 9
programme.desc: Một nhóm bạn tụ họp sau nhiều năm xa cách, họ quyết định tổ chức một buổi cắm trại trong rừng. Mọi việc đều diễn ra vui vẻ cho tới khi họ vô tình bước vào khu vực cấm, hàng loạt sự kiện bất thường xảy ra.

programme.title: ĐẠI PHỤNG ĐẢ CANH NHÂN - GUARDIANS OF THE DAFENG, TẬP 10
programme.desc: Dương Lăng có khao khát trở thành cảnh sát, nhưng một tai nạn ập đến khiến anh lạc vào một thế giới khác. Khi tỉnh lại, anh thấy mình đang bị giam trong ngục chờ bị áp giải ra biên cương. Để thay đổi số mệnh bi đát, anh bắt buộc phải tự rửa oan cho mình và gia nhập tổ chức Đả Canh Nhân.

programme.title: CHUNG CƯ CÓ ĐỘC - HAPPINESS, TẬP 10
programme.desc: Phim kể về những người mắc phải căn bệnh truyền nhiễm, được phát hiện bắt nguồn từ một loại thuốc lạ. Mọi người bị cô lập trong một căn hộ chung cư phân tầng địa vị và những cuộc đấu tranh sống còn với căn bệnh đang lây lan ngày một nhanh và nhiều.

programme.title: CUỘC CHIẾN HỦY DIỆT 3 - SKYLIN3S
programme.desc: Loại virus mới biến người ngoài hành tinh trở nên hung dữ, đe dọa loài người trên Trái Đất. Đội trưởng Rose Corley dẫn đầu một đội lính đánh thuê xuất sắc để chiến đấu tại thế giới ngoài hành tinh và cứu loài người khỏi sự tàn phá của virus này.

programme.title: TÔNG SƯ HOẮC NGUYÊN GIÁP
programme.desc: Phim kể về cuộc đời của Hoắc Nguyên Giáp và hành trình trở thành tông sư công phu. Khi còn tuổi thiếu niên, Nguyên Giáp không nghe lời khuyên của cha, một lòng chỉ muốn lấy võ phục người, bỏ nhà đến Tân Môn lập nghiệp.

Họ cùng lên kế hoạch xâm nhập hang ổ của Zeta để ngăn chặn cuộc chiến. Khi đối mặt với một kẻ thù, việc gác lại hiềm khích và đoàn kết sẽ tạo ra sức mạnh để vượt qua mọi khó khăn.
